name: NT apprentice travel and accommodation subsidy
summary: Partial subsidy for NT apprentices and trainees who live more than 50 km from the training provider for their off-the-job training.
key: 50 cents per km by road and $700 per full week of accommodation plus $100 per extra day.
who: NT-registered apprentices and trainees funded under User Choice
Live more than 50 km one way from the nearest RTO offering the training
how: Claim through your Apprentice Connect Australia provider.
catches: Maximum of four travel claims per calendar year.
Policy signed 5 June 2023; check rates are still current.

source.label: NT Department of Education: Apprenticeship and traineeship travel and accommodation subsidy scheme policy

evidence.quote: Road - 50 cents per kilometre (>50km one way).
An apprentice may claim an accommodation subsidy of $700 for a full week (seven days) and $100 for each extra day.
All apprentices and trainees registered in the NT whose training is funded under user choice
